title: 3 Extras Not to Miss When Comparing Rolling Steel Service Doors
summary: Janus Rolling Steel Service Doors: 3 extras not to miss when comparing rolling steel service doors.
body_markdown:
When it comes to commercial and industrial applications, not all rolling steel doors are created equal. Warehouses, freight terminals, distribution centers and loading docks require doors that deliver strength, security and dependable performance. But there's more to selecting the right door than durability alone. From wind-load protection and faster operating speeds to extended cycle life and thermal efficiency that saves energy costs, different applications demand different performance capabilities.


And that's why we offer a comprehensive line of[commercial rolling steel service doors](https://www.janusintl.com/rolling-steel-doors) engineered to meet these challenges. Whether the priority is added protection, increased speed and high-cycle performance or energy savings, the right solution can help improve operational efficiency, reduce downtime, save you money and deliver long-term value.


## **Extra Protection: Janus 400 Series Heavy Duty Service Door**


In


demanding commercial and industrial environments, strength and durability are essential. Doors must withstand daily wear while providing dependable protection against environmental conditions and potential security threats.


The **Janus 400 Series Heavy Duty Service Door** is engineered for strength, versatility and lasting performance, making it an ideal solution for a wide range of industrial and commercial applications, including facilities in high-wind regions. Here are the highlights:


- Manufactured from commercial-grade galvanized steel, the 400 Series features durable slats available in 24-, 22-, 20- and 18-gauge configurations, with flat, curved and perforated profiles to accommodate different application requirements.


- For projects requiring additional protection against severe weather, the 400 Series offers optional **wind-load rated configurations and Miami-Dade impact certification, with certified configurations rated up to +60/-65 PSF.**


- Standard features include an enclosed hood, reduction gear chain hoist, three-piece structural steel guides and a double-angle bottom bar with an astragal. Together, these components provide the strength and structural integrity needed for demanding environments.


- With available widths up to 40 feet and heights up to 30 feet, depending on the model, the 400 Series also offers the flexibility to accommodate large commercial and industrial openings.


For applications where protection, durability and versatility are the primary considerations, the Janus 400 Series delivers a dependable solution built to perform.


## **Extra Speed: Janus 400HP Series High-Performance Door**


In high-traffic industrial environments, every second counts. Frequent opening and closing can slow operations, interrupt workflow and increase wear on door components.


The **Janus 400HP Series High-Performance Door** is designed to keep operations moving **with opening speeds of up to 24 inches per second—up to 3 times faster than standard rolling steel service doors.** Other benefits include:


- Engineered for high-performance applications, the 400HP Series combines speed, durability and security at a fraction of the cost of traditional high-speed door products.


- Its specialized springless barrel design provides a standard cycle life of 400,000 cycles (and the option of 600,000 cycles), approximately 16 times that of a standard service door. This extended cycle life makes the 400HP an ideal choice for facilities where frequent operation is essential.


- The 400HP also features a DC motor with soft-start and soft-stop technology, helping reduce mechanical wear while supporting smooth, controlled operation.


- The faster operating speed can also help reduce the time an opening remains exposed, supporting temperature management in commercial and industrial buildings.


For distribution centers, manufacturing facilities and other high-traffic applications, the 400HP Series delivers a powerful combination of speed, efficiency and long-term performance.


## Extra Savings: Janus 600 Series Insulated Service Door


F


or commercial and industrial facilities that require both frequent operation and thermal efficiency, selecting the right rolling steel door is critical.


The **Janus 600 Series Insulated Rolling Service Door** combines rugged construction with R-7.2


insulation for energy reduction that can clock potential savings of $12,000 to $25,000 annually in a 100,000 sq. ft. warehouse


.


Here’s what you can expect from this versatile solution that's a must for climate-controlled applications:


- Manufactured from commercial-grade steel, the 600 Series features insulated flat slats available in 24-, 22-, 20- and 18-gauge configurations. Each slat incorporates a 5/8-inch-thick polyurethane foam core, delivering an R-value of 7.2 to help reduce heat transfer and support temperature control.


- The 600 Series also offers high-cycle spring configurations designed to accommodate frequent operation, making it well suited for facilities where dependable access and long-term performance are essential.


- Standard features include an enclosed hood, reduction gear chain hoist, three-piece structural steel guides and a double-angle bottom bar with a weather seal.


- For applications requiring additional protection, optional wind-load rated and Miami-Dade impact-certified configurations are also available.


The combination of thermal efficiency, durable construction and high-cycle capabilities makes the 600 Series a practical solution for warehouses, manufacturing facilities and other commercial and industrial environments where performance matters.


## Janus Commercial: Superior Quality. Superior Performance.


Selecting the right rolling steel door starts with understanding the demands of the application. Whether the priority is protection against severe weather, faster access, extended cycle life or energy efficiency, Janus delivers solutions engineered for lasting performance.


With a comprehensive line of high-quality rolling steel doors, faster lead times, easy installation and minimal maintenance, Janus provides the strength, reliability and versatility required for today's commercial and industrial applications.
